source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1955, p. 8 ("Only one contest in the Antrim County Council elections"); Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1955, p. 4 ("Local government elections: polling will take place to-day")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: official notice lists 23 county electoral divisions and fixes the election for Thursday 2 June 1955 (Belfast News-Letter, 4 May 1955, p. 1); 'There will be only one contest in the Antrim County Council elections' (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1955, p. 8).

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council on the 23 county electoral divisions; nominations received on 17 May 1955, withdrawals to 18 May, and polling on Thursday 2 June 1955 (official notice, Belfast News-Letter, 4 May 1955, p. 1; 'POLLING will take place to-day', Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1955, p. 4). Only Ballygomartin was contested. Party labels were printed only for the two Ballygomartin candidates, both shown as (U.). Returned unopposed.
